correctness.rationale: The exact face decomposition A union_B (S0*B) plus all central 1-cells follows from the classification by central vertex count. Joins of complete-graph one-skeleta give rank a in degree 2n-1, joins of discrete sets give rank b in degree n-1; A is (2n-2)-connected and both B attaching maps are null. The homotopy pushout produces high and middle sphere wedges, and central edges yield choose(s,2) circles. Equivariant long exact sequences give integral modules; finite group transfer proves quotient rationally acyclic. Independent combinatorial face/rank and signed Lefschetz tests cover six finite parameter cases, 1751 faces, 255 automorphisms including all 144 of the smallest case. No infinite proof is attributed to the checker.

value.rationale: The natural chordal but diamond-containing clique-join graph family falls outside the 2026 diamond-free shellability criterion. This is a full nonuniform infinite classification with three distinct integral homology degrees, a natural complete automorphism module in each degree, and a rationally acyclic quotient. The extra circle representation and center tensor structure are not routine counts from the single-center formula. These precise invariants give a useful boundary test for clique-free complexes with overlapping triangle constraints.
